{{Quote|A ship doesn't give ID, we assume aggressive status!|Ganno|<ref name="FF" />}}
'''Ganno''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]] he was stationed in the [[Maximum Security Section]] of the [[Belsavis prison]], where he ordered the artillery to shoot down a ship that did not response to a request to provide ID. Though Sergeant [[Nerrick]] disagreed with Ganno's decision, it was proven correct when a Republic citizen uncovered that the ship belonged to a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] trying to supply to aid in the escape of a crime lord imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="FF" />
